labels: RESEARCH DATA -- public venue facts and BOOK STATE ONLY; never a fill, never P&L
source: https://gateway.polymarket.us public GETs, unsigned, no credentials, read 2026-11-28

files.hourly_<asset>.jsonl.gz:
GET /v1/market/slug/

-updown-1h-z for every hour 2026-11-07T17Z .. 2026-11-28 (resolved); fields from market.assetPriceTerms: windowStart (ws), windowEnd (we), indexSymbol (idx), priceToBeat (ptb), settlementPrice (settle); market.outcomePrices ([1,0] = Up). 'desc' kept on a sample of rows.
files.5m_<asset>.jsonl.gz: same read for the 5m series every 5 minutes 2026-11-14T17Z .. ; their ptb is the venue's official 60-print CF Benchmarks average at each 5-minute mark. rows with http=404: the venue listed no market for that slot.
files.hourly_books_live.jsonl.gz: bounded live capture, about every 20 s, of GET /v1/markets/<hourly slug>/book top of book for the current hour (gap ~18:33-18:36Z while the capture restarted).

not_available: CF Benchmarks RTI prints themselves (cfbenchmarks.com and exchange spot APIs are refused by this sandbox's proxy); historical venue books for hourly windows before this capture
